inference_only_selector_definition: Both unchanged original 8 Qwen model samples undergo identical physical SQLite execution. Baseline gives one vote to each physically executable SQL sample. Treatment collapses only conservative exact SQL program duplicates (whitespace/case outside SQL quoted literals, one trailing semicolon), then gives one vote per distinct program and selects highest-frequency output-result set; deterministic earliest-index tie. No reference/EX/labels in either selector. No SQL regeneration.
judgment: The widespread SQL repetition is real but is not sufficient evidence that the repeated result is wrong. Removing model sample consensus weighting reduced matched strict set EX by 10/499 and bag EX by 10/499. Selection-only changes cannot reach 215/500 original K8 questions that had no correct SQL candidate. Do not promote, retune based on DEV500 labels, claim independent out-of-database improvement, or run HOLDOUT300.
limitations: Full 500 original DEV case IDs verified, but 1 expensive original publisher reference SQL (#1126) timed out under frozen 8s SQLite evaluation and was censored: strict EX denominators are 499, NOT 500.
All 11 BIRD DEV physical databases had been used in earlier experiments; these are not independent DB-level generalization results.
Previously existing 4,000 original Qwen SQL candidates reused; no new correct candidate generated.
Original DEV500 outcomes are historically exposed and cannot establish unbiased independent effect estimation.
Physically bounded execution and result-row limit may differ from a separate official leaderboard evaluator.
next_research_focus: Stop source posthoc majority-vote changes and small heuristic patch loops. Investigate a distinct model-fixed candidate-generation capability on adequately sized predeclared TRAIN data, ideally source-shift or independent DBs; keep original two protected BIRD TRAIN DBs and BIRD DEV HOLDOUT300 sealed. Only then revisit final strict EX.
